task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for EXT-01 at src/design/ext-01-service-task-node.md. Define SERVICE_TASK execution semantics from activation through completion/failure, including request construction (URL/method/optional headers), timeout behavior (default 30s with timeout_ms override), redirect handling (3xx treated as failure), retry policy (default N=3 configurable per node with exponential backoff), and terminal failure routing to OBS-05 DLQ with EE-10 ERROR transition. Specify success-path response handling: HTTP 2xx JSON object merge into instance variables per EE-09, and explicit ERROR transition when 2xx body is not a JSON object. Include trace propagation requirements (API-09 trace_id in outgoing headers), node-activation validation rules (including empty templated URL edge case), idempotency and side-effect safety considerations for retries, module boundaries, and concrete implementation touchpoints in engine/api/obs modules. Include a complete requirement traceability matrix mapping all EXT-01 acceptance criteria and edge cases to modules/functions and required tests (unit + integration). Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design fully maps every EXT-01 acceptance criterion and edge case to explicit behavior
Retry/backoff, timeout, redirect, and DLQ/ERROR transitions are concrete and testable
Success-path variable-merge and invalid-2xx-body ERROR behavior are precisely specified
Trace propagation and security considerations for outbound HTTP calls are explicit
Traceability matrix identifies implementation modules and verification hooks

result.summary: Design artefact for EXT-01 service task node completed at src/design/ext-01-service-task-node.md, including activation-to-terminal execution semantics, outbound request/trace/idempotency contracts, timeout and retry/backoff behavior, redirect and 429 failure treatment, 2xx object-merge and invalid-body ERROR handling, OBS-05 DLQ + EE-10 routing, and complete traceability to modules/functions/tests.
